curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When clashing outsiders collide in a single room on a holiday night, how long can the hotline workers keep total catastrophe at bay?
curatedMovie.description: On Christmas Eve, two neurotic volunteers staffing a suicide hotline find their shift spiraling out of control when an unpredictable mix of eccentric visitors descends upon their cramped office.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast, chaotic, and lighthearted; an easy-watching 88-minute comedy built on relentless momentum and group friction.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Jean-Marie Poiré delivers a fast-paced French farce where holiday cheer is upended by manic escalation and sharp, unapologetic situational humor.
